Hannah Lee: Quick review request for the alert thresholds + notification preview iteration. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def (frames: thresholds/compact-v1, preview/runtime-order). Looking for copy + accessibility quick wins before Friday.

Rafael Ortiz: Main UX problem I saw: preview order doesn't reflect runtime routing. That causes false confidence when teams test suppression rules. Ideally preview shows routing order (priority -> fallback) and highlights which channel will receive the alert.

Maya Singh: Agree. Also noticed we use 'Mute for' in the threshold row but 'Snooze' in the modal. Pick one. My vote: 'Snooze' is more explicit for users.

Zoe Kim: Accessibility notes: 1) the compact threshold chip has 3px focus ring on keyboard which is hard to see, 2) the channel pills aren't reachable by tab because the channel list is a single focusable container. Need per-pill focus.

Accessibility Bot: Suggestion: give each pill role="button" with tabindex="0" and a visible focus style. Add aria-pressed for toggles. Announce preview mode changes with aria-live="polite".

Hannah Lee: Good call. On copy: propose changing the modal CTA from 'Apply' to 'Save preview' to reduce ambiguity about persistence. Also helper copy under the duration should read: 'Snooze notifications in selected channels for the chosen window.' Thoughts?

Rafael Ortiz: 'Save preview' is clearer. Small UX idea: show a tiny runtime badge (icon + "runtime") on the channel that would actually get the alert. That makes routing obvious in a glance.

Maya Singh: For mobile layout the threshold slider + numeric field cramp each other. Suggest collapsing to numeric input with a micro-progress bar for visual context (and keep the slider for desktop).

Zoe Kim: Keyboard interaction: when user tabs through pills, pressing space should toggle inclusion/exclusion. Also ensure screen readers see order; use aria-posinset/aria-setsize if using role=listitem.

Hannah Lee: Action plan: Rafael will prototype runtime-badging + ordering in preview, Zoe will detail the keyboard/focus changes and a11y attributes, Maya will update copy doc to standardize on 'Snooze', I'll swap CTA to 'Save preview' in the mock. Reconvene Fri 11am to sign off.

Accessibility Bot: Reminder: include unit tests for aria-live announcements and keyboard nav in the PR.

Rafael Ortiz: I'll add the prototype and a small animation showing fallback routing. ETA: Thursday EOD.

Maya Singh: Copy PR drafted. Will share link in this thread when ready.

Hannah Lee: Thanks all! :thumbsup:
